content:
It's the weekend and the AirPods Pro 3 discount of 25% off is still live, as is a straight $100 off AirPods Max 2. Today's top deal in the 9to5Toys Lunch Break, though, is the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returning to $1,099 via the official Apple Refurbished Store with all three colorways in stock (that's $200 in savings) — a model that typically sells out fast, so you'll want to act quickly. We also have the new MacBook Neo marked down by up to $120, Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Natural or Black Milanese Loop band at nearly $100 off on Amazon, and the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable at Amazon's low of $18 with free shipping for Prime members (that's 60% off). Don't forget to check out the updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals below.

AirPods summer deals continue: $100 off Max 2, AirPods Pro 3 25% off from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 (ANC) $149 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 (ANC) $119 (Reg. $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy refreshes 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, $130 off Bose, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen appliances, more

Most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to $1,099 via official Apple Refurbished Store with all three colors in stock (save $200)

The official Apple Refurbished Store has always been a great place to save some cash, especially as the MacBook lineup has seen price increases at retail. While stock of base configurations for the Pro and M5 MacBook Air lines can fluctuate, this morning we're seeing the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air base configuration available across all three colors at $1,099 — that's $200 below MSRP.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage at $1,099 with free shipping. As of writing, this deal applies to the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These products come with:

  • Apple's 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple's 14-day return policy
  • Eligibility to purchase AppleCare
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment process before sale

What you're looking at here is the base configuration M5 MacBook Air that retails for $1,299 new. Today's Apple Refurbished Store deal is $200 below that MSRP, which is the lowest price we've tracked for current models.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

The Apple Refurbished Store might be the best place on the market to buy a refurbished MacBook Air, but how does it compare to the current retail price for new units?

Amazon is now charging near full price for this configuration, with only the Silver model coming in slightly lower at $1,240. While this machine has gone for less than that, we haven't seen Amazon dip below $1,149 on a new unit since the price increase, and even then, that was a fleeting flash deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop band at nearly $100 off on Amazon

If I may, two of the best-looking smartwatch configurations on Amazon right now are both at nearly $100 off — the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with a Natural Titanium or Black Milanese Loop band.

While the cheaper $100 discount on the Ocean Band configuration is gone, Amazon is now selling the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Milanese Loop for $799.99 with free shipping.

These two configurations are nearly $100 off on Amazon given the Milanese Loop's $899 MSRP:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)

Apple is expected to unveil its next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but RAM price hikes have already impacted the iPad and MacBook lines, and new Apple Watches could be next. The current lineup is unaffected for now, but since they're essentially mini computers on your wrist, the Ultra 4 or Series 12 could be next in line for price increases.

We certainly wouldn't blame anyone for waiting to see what else Apple has in store for September, but with less than a month to go, these prices could go even higher.

Series models are also expected to stay the same, and their $100 discounts are still live on Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Score the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable at Amazon's low of $18 (60% off) with free shipping for Prime members

While the 240W black variant is still at its all-time low of $18 with free Prime shipping, you'll want to act fast to grab a few of these 10-foot Beats braided USB-C cables.

Amazon is now pricing the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C braided cable at $18.03 with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

These 2026 models with upgraded power delivery specs retail for $30, which honestly is quite expensive even for a premium 10-foot USB-C cable. But at 60% off MSRP, I think everyone should have a few of these high-end, better-looking models in their everyday carry or home collection.

Today's main low is on the Bolt Black colorway, but there are also Navy at $19, Surge Stone at $20.85 after clipping the on-page coupon, and red coming in just under $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, upgraded from the previous generation's 60W to a robust 240W power delivery, extended to 10 feet, while maintaining the same tangle-resistant braided design: "More durable and convenient. Upgrade your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, bends, and wear — choose our reinforced braided cables."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular at $100 off from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand falls back to Prime Day all-time low (65% off)

After testing it earlier this year, Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a mainstay in my everyday carry, travel bag, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 65% off, we have another chance to pick it up at the lowest Amazon price we've tracked.

The official Anker Amazon Store is now selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

This charging accessory retails for $150 and features 3-in-1 functionality, with the MagSafe pad delivering up to 25W output. Both the Phantom Black and Glacial White versions are nearly 65% off MSRP.

This week's deal matches the one previously mentioned, aligning with Anker's major summer sale and this year's Prime Day pricing.

While this device is compact and portable, it has some weight to it, so it sits securely on your desk or nightstand, performing excellently whether at a home workstation or on the go.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Belkin's new ultra-compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable drops to just $25
  • Power all your devices on your desk for just $60 — SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank with built-in dual cables drops to $33 (42% off)
  • Acer braided USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supports 240W charging, 8K, and more for $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display drops to just $56 today
  • Top pick: New Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with ultra-wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent 'Ghost' SmartCard Find My wallet tracker falls back to Amazon low
  • Spigen mini MagSafe iPhone backpack / everyday carry organizer drops to $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter for 'over 200 countries and regions' drops to $20

Official Apple Refurbished Store sells MacBook Neo at lowest prices, up to $120 off MSRP

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's more affordable new MacBook Neo has also seen a recent price increase, but you can avoid that markup through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store — the MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but you can get configurations with full Apple warranty starting at $599 through Apple's best refurbished store.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest price we've found at any reputable retailer, with the same official Apple warranty and Apple's 'rigorous' refurbished quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

While the Apple Refurbished Store product pages don't seem to show any specific promotions, all models are at least $100 below current MSRP — the 512GB model with the Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 below current MSRP and $20 below its previous pricing.

Yes, these are refurbished units, and yes, they simply bring the price back to near the old MSRP, but this is the lowest price available for the most affordable MacBook in the current generation.

For some people, choosing refurbished to save $100 to $120 isn't worth it, and that's completely understandable — but that savings is certainly not insignificant, and we're talking about the highest quality refurbished units directly from Apple.
